title: CIT168 · native probabilistic subcortical atlas

space.name: CIT168 native population template
space.reference: Pauli, Nili and Tyszka (2018), native 700 micrometer T1w/T2w templates and OSF jkzwp snapshot
space.correspondence: Images, categorical labels and probability channels share the delivered native grid. This package is not MNI space. No alignment with another atlas or individual is implied.

sources.title: CIT168 subcortical atlas
sources.version: Native 700 micrometer OSF snapshot; SHA256-pinned inputs
sources.citation: Pauli WM, Nili AN, Tyszka JM. A high-resolution probabilistic in vivo atlas of human subcortical brain nuclei. Scientific Data 5, 180063 (2018). doi:10.1038/sdata.2018.63. Derived from Human Connectome Project data.

acquisition: Run neuroimage acquire cit168_native --data-root <existing-data-root>. Direct source files remain in downloads without duplicate expansion.

probability_interpretation: Source observer-assignment support on a population template, on a 0 to 1 scale; not individual anatomy, population prevalence or clinical confidence.
probability_derivation: Left: mean of 24 manually delineated volumes. Right: source-author reflection warp from the left with affine/diffeomorphic mapping and third-order B-spline interpolation. Channels are extracted exactly; no new mirroring, registration, interpolation or thresholding.

hard_label_rule.evidence: Voxelwise comparison with the delivered det_atlas_25 file; this rule is an empirical verification of the pinned release, not an assumed filename convention.

probabilities.name: Extended amygdala
notes: The source combines bed nuclei of the stria terminalis and sublenticular extended amygdala; an indistinguishable interstitial component is omitted. This is not a whole-amygdala label.
